items.title: Allstate (ALL) Stock Still Looks Below Fair Value After Strong Gains
items.summary: Allstate stock has delivered very strong returns in recent years, yet the broader valuation checks still suggest the shares lean cheap rather than fully pricing in that strength. Over the past 3 years, Allstate has returned about 149.5%, which puts recent short term pullbacks in a longer run of strong gains.
